description: This file is a C++ source file implementing a test client for the RemoteControl service API. It includes code for invoking various remote methods, handling user input to test different functionalities such as retrieving IR codes, starting pairing, and other remote control operations, as well as managing event subscriptions.

methods.name: showMenu
methods.description: Displays a menu for user to select remote control API test options.

methods.description: Formats JSON string output for better display.

methods.name: formatColumns
methods.description: Formats JSON string to display in columns based on console width.
